name: Pokemon Top Movers - nightly snapshot + daily image

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS card_prices (
  snap_date date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
  card_id text NOT NULL,
  variant text NOT NULL,
  name text, set_name text, number text, rarity text,
  image_small text, image_large text,
  market numeric(10,2),
  tcg_updated text,
  PRIMARY KEY (snap_date, card_id, variant)
);

parameters.jsCode:
// 120 pages x 250 cards = 30,000 card capacity. Empty pages return no data.
return Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => ({ json: { page: i + 1 } }));

parameters.query:
=WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snap_date) AS d FROM card_prices),
base_day AS (
  SELECT max(snap_date) AS d FROM card_prices, latest
  WHERE snap_date <= latest.d - make_interval(days => {{ $json.windowDays }})
),
m AS (
  SELECT c.card_id, c.variant, c.name, c.set_name, c.number, c.rarity,
         c.image_small, c.image_large,
         c.snap_date::text AS cur_date, b.snap_date::text AS base_date,
         b.market AS old_price, c.market AS new_price,
         ROUND((c.market - b.market) / b.market * 100, 1) AS pct
  FROM card_prices c
  JOIN card_prices b ON b.card_id = c.card_id AND b.variant = c.variant
  WHERE c.snap_date = (SELECT d FROM latest)
    AND b.snap_date = (SELECT d FROM base_day)
    AND b.market >= {{ $json.minPrice }}
    AND c.market >= {{ $json.minPrice }}
)
(SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY pct DESC LIMIT 8)
UNION ALL
(SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY pct ASC LIMIT 8);
